lead_headline: Weekend freeze persists as restaurant tracker logs three more dead days while Aurora filing hits $4.9M

restaurant.blurb: Three-day weekend silence extends June freeze to 14 days—detection machinery logged zero new leads Friday through Sunday as metropolitan Denver restaurant scene remains frozen, no openings or closures detected across all neighborhoods.

foreclosure.blurb: Airport Road and Hughes Road property in Aurora filed at $4.9 million in Arapahoe County, auction scheduled June 5.

liquor.blurb: Weekend blackout extends June paralysis to 38 consecutive days—Colorado's licensing machinery remained frozen Friday through Sunday with zero applications, zero status changes across 12,396 tracked licenses. The three-day weekend silence deepens month's regulatory gridlock as state apparatus logs eighth, ninth, and tenth straight zero-activity days. June's opening fortnight now mirrors May's unprecedented shutdown pattern with no filing activity whatsoever. The invisible backlog swells while licensing infrastructure posts longest documented freeze in modern state history, weekend silence offering no hint of thaw as apparatus enters third full week of complete inactivity.

reputation.blurb: One mention yesterday as Sunday coverage included Traffic Turbo analysis on Reddit. Weekly tally: 35 pickups across 9 sources, down 22% from prior week's 45 mentions as June weekend wraps second consecutive week of declining media attention. Denver Post led weekend with 8 citations, Facebook contributed 6, Reddit logged 5 including Saturday's moving-to-Denver apartment query and Sunday's traffic discussion. Notable Saturday pickups: $9.5M Cherry Hills sale (Denver Post), 76ers president hire (Facebook). Week-over-week slide accelerates from prior period's 16% drop as media interest cools entering second full June week, Google News RSS driving 97% of discovery while Reddit RSS contributed single organic mention.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +6 since Friday (9 new, 3 canceled) lifts MTD net to +10 (+1.4/day), 90-day net stands at +129. Weekend delivered modest net +2 Friday through Sunday after prior week's Thursday-Friday surge posted net +5 across two days, recent three-week pattern shows pronounced volatility with multi-day freezes punctuated by burst activity. Current 7-day window (+10) matches prior period (+11) as June stabilizes around +1.4/day pace, modestly outpacing YTD velocity (+1.3/day) while trailing May's stronger back-half momentum that averaged +2.1/day in month's final two weeks.
